candidates.name: hidradenoma papilliferum
support_spans: a circumscribed tumor contiguous with adjoining normal epidermis and delineated from underlying dermis by continuous apocrine epithelial lining
tumor epithelium with multiple papillary projections with vascular, plasma cell–rich stroma
candidates.why: The description of the tumor's architecture and location suggests a hidradenoma papilliferum, a rare benign tumor.

candidates.name: apocrine gland carcinoma
support_spans: Several foci showed papillary projections lined by multilayered epithelium with atypical cells, few mitotic figures, and areas of necrosis but no dermal invasion
candidates.why: The presence of atypical cells and mitotic figures raises concern for a malignant process, such as apocrine gland carcinoma.
